messages:
marta: Quick heads-up — CI started failing on the py38/py39 jobs after my last PR that bumped httpx. Local tests pass, but mypy/type-checking step errors out in the build matrix.

marta: Error snippet from CI: `error: Incompatible types in assignment (expression has type "MockTransport", variable has type "httpx._types.SyncTransport")` and also `TypeError: __init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'trust_env'` when running our small runner harness.

leo: ugh, that smells like a transitive change in httpx or types stubs. Can you paste your poetry.lock / pip freeze from the environment that fails?

marta: here's the relevant part from CI venv (copied):
```
httpx==0.25.1
httpcore==0.17.1
typing-extensions==4.7.1
types-requests==2.31.0.1
```
marta: my local env uses httpx 0.25.0 and CI pulls 0.25.1 (we pin in pyproject but lockfile updated by the bot yesterday).

shiv: quick theory — types-requests vs httpx/httpcore API surface mismatch. mypy might be using types from requests for some symbols that httpx now exposes differently. Also httpx changed transport API a while back.

marta: repro steps I ran in tox env: `tox -e py39 -- tests/unit/test_streaming.py::TestStreamClient` — fails in the async streaming fixture when we use `asyncio.get_event_loop()` inside uvloop vs builtin. Error goes away if I set `asyncio.set_event_loop_policy(asyncio.WindowsSelectorEventLoopPolicy())` (weird but indicates event loop policy interaction).

leo: two parallel issues — (1) typing mismatch; (2) streaming harness depending on loop policy. For (1) we can try pinning the compatible types package in CI or add an explicit types-compat shim. For (2) maybe our test harness needs to prefer `asyncio.new_event_loop()` rather than `get_event_loop()` to be deterministic.

marta: I tried forcing httpx==0.25.0 in CI via env override and pipeline passed. But we don't want to permanently pin backwards.

shiv: Can we bump our mypy config to ignore the specific import until we sort the stubs? Add `# type: ignore[attr-defined]` in the failing assignment as a short-term fix?

leo: I think better to add a devex checklist item: update lockfile + run `tox -e types-check` in the lockfile CI job before merge. Also @ci-bot can we add a matrix column to run mypy against the latest transitive set so PRs catch this? :thinking_face:

ci-bot: Posted — added new CI job `types-matrix` that runs mypy across minor versions of httpx & typing-extensions. See pipeline 6521.

marta: thanks. For the streaming oddity, I'll open a small PR to change the fixture to `loop = asyncio.new_event_loop(); asyncio.set_event_loop(loop)` and see if that stabilizes on ubuntu/containers and macos runners.

shiv: PTAL @leo for lockfile policy change and @marta for the test fixture PR. If both are green, we can revert the temporary httpx pin.

leo: pinging in the CR — will review today. Also propose adding a short note in CONTRIBUTING.md about relying on `python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel` in CI to avoid old wheel behaviours.

marta: ack, will add the CONTRIBUTING blurb in the test-fix PR. Thanks all. :thumbsup:


deploy-bot: Note — no production deploys affected. This is CI-only failure.

marta: follow-up — if anyone hits this locally: `poetry lock --no-update` then `poetry install --no-root` will reproduce the CI lock resolution that caused the bump. Saved me debugging time.

leo: solid. Marking this thread resolved for now. Will reopen if the types-matrix finds other permutations.
